ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) background occupying approximately 75-80% of the surface area, contrasted with low-intensity (black) focal pigmentation spots occupying 20-25%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density distribution of discrete, non-contiguous black circular and elliptical mottling blobs across both lobes; clusters are significantly more concentrated toward the trailing edge and the lateral tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees, centered between the primary lobe masses.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary; characterized by low-amplitude pixel peaks and high-frequency shallow valleys, isolated against the darker water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning into a slight concavity before reaching the tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized cluster of high-relief, brownish-white pixel clusters at the distal tip of the right lobe, consistent with coronulid barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct, dark-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the mid-region of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical deformation at the tip of the right lobe due to heavy barnacle encrustation; no major amputations visible.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-frequency 'dalmatian-style' spotting pattern that covers the entirety of the visible ventral fluke surface.
